verses.en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
verses.fr: Paul, apôtre de Jésus-Christ par la volonté de Dieu, et le frère Timothée, à l''Eglise de Dieu qui est à Corinthe, et à tous les saints qui sont dans toute l''Achaïe:
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያ የሆነ ጳውሎስ ወንድሙም ጢሞቴዎስ፥ በአካይያ አገር ሁሉ ከሚኖሩ ቅዱሳን ሁሉ ጋር በቆሮንቶስ ላለች ለእግዚአብሔር ቤተ ክርስቲያን፤

verses.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: que la grâce et la paix vous soient données de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus-Christ!
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.en: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
verses.fr: Béni soit Dieu, le Père de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, le Père des miséricordes et le Dieu de toute consolation,
verses.am: የርኅራኄ አባት የመጽናናትም ሁሉ አምላክ የሆነ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አምላክና አባት ይባረክ።

verses.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
verses.fr: qui nous console dans toutes nos afflictions, afin que, par la consolation dont nous sommes l''objet de la part de Dieu, nous puissions consoler ceux qui se trouvent dans quelque affliction!
verses.am: እርሱ በመከራችን ሁሉ ያጽናናናል፥ ስለዚህም እኛ ራሳችን በእግዚአብሔር በምንጽናናበት መጽናናት በመከራ ሁሉ ያሉትን ማጽናናት እንችላለን።

verses.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
verses.fr: Car, de même que les souffrances de Christ abondent en nous, de même notre consolation abonde par Christ.
verses.am: የክርስቶስ ሥቃይ በእኛ ላይ እንደ በዛ፥ እንዲሁ መጽናናታችን ደግሞ በክርስቶስ በኩል ይበዛልናልና።

verses.en: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
verses.fr: Si nous sommes affligés, c''est pour votre consolation et pour votre salut; si nous sommes consolés, c''est pour votre consolation, qui se réalise par la patience à supporter les mêmes souffrances que nous endurons.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን መከራ ብንቀበል፥ ስለ መጽናናታችሁና ስለ መዳናችሁ ነው፤ ብንጽናናም፥ እኛ ደግሞ የምንሣቀይበት በዚያ ሥቃይ በመጽናት ስለሚደረግ ስለ መጽናናታችሁ ነው።

verses.en: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
verses.fr: Et notre espérance à votre égard est ferme, parce que nous savons que, si vous avez part aux souffrances, vous avez part aussi à la consolation.
verses.am: ተስፋችንም ስለ እናንተ ጽኑ ነው፤ ሥቃያችንን እንደ ተካፈላችሁ እንዲሁም መጽናናታችንን ደግሞ እንድትካፈሉ እናውቃለንና።

verses.en: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
verses.fr: Nous ne voulons pas, en effet, vous laisser ignorer, frères, au sujet de la tribulation qui nous est survenue en Asie, que nous avons été excessivement accablés, au delà de nos forces, de telle sorte que nous désespérions même de conserver la vie.
verses.am: በእስያ ስለ ደረሰብን መከራችን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ታውቁ ዘንድ እንወዳለንና፤ ስለ ሕይወታችን እንኳ ተስፋ እስክንቆርጥ ድረስ ከዓቅማችን በላይ ያለ ልክ ከብዶብን ነበር፤

verses.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
verses.fr: Et nous regardions comme certain notre arrêt de mort, afin de ne pas placer notre confiance en nous-mêmes, mais de la placer en Dieu, qui ressuscite les morts.
verses.am: አዎን፥ ሙታንን በሚያነሣ በእግዚአብሔር እንጂ በራሳችን እንዳንታመን፥ እኛ ራሳችን የሞትን ፍርድ በውስጣችን ሰምተን ነበር።

verses.en: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
verses.fr: C''est lui qui nous a délivrés et qui nous délivrera d''une telle mort, lui de qui nous espérons qu''il nous délivrera encore,
verses.am: ትምክህታችን ይህ ነውና፤ በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ እንጂ በሥጋዊ ጥበብ ሳይሆን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቅድስናና ቅንነት በዚህ ዓለም ይልቁንም በእናንተ ዘንድ እንደኖርን የሕሊናችን ምስክርነት ነው።

verses.en: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
verses.fr: vous-mêmes aussi nous assistant de vos prières, afin que la grâce obtenue pour nous par plusieurs soit pour plusieurs une occasion de rendre grâces à notre sujet.
verses.am: ትምክህታችን ይህ ነውና፤ በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ እንጂ በሥጋዊ ጥበብ ሳይሆን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቅድስናና ቅንነት በዚህ ዓለም ይልቁንም በእናንተ ዘንድ እንደኖርን የሕሊናችን ምስክርነት ነው።

verses.en: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
verses.fr: Car ce qui fait notre gloire, c''est ce témoignage de notre conscience, que nous nous sommes conduits dans le monde, et surtout à votre égard, avec sainteté et pureté devant Dieu, non point avec une sagesse charnelle, mais avec la grâce de Dieu.
verses.am: በዚህም ታምኜ፥ ሁለተኛ ጸጋ ታገኙ ዘንድ አስቀድሜ ወደ እናንተ እንድመጣ፥

verses.en: For we write none other things unto you, that what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
verses.fr: Nous ne vous écrivons pas autre chose que ce que vous lisez, et ce que vous reconnaissez. Et j''espère que vous le reconnaîtrez jusqu''à la fin,
verses.am: በዚህም ታምኜ፥ ሁለተኛ ጸጋ ታገኙ ዘንድ አስቀድሜ ወደ እናንተ እንድመጣ፥

verses.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are our's in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.fr: comme vous avez déjà reconnu en partie que nous sommes votre gloire, de même que vous serez aussi la nôtre au jour du Seigneur Jésus.
verses.am: በእናንተም መካከል ወደ መቄዶንያ እንዳልፍ ደግሞም ከመቄዶንያ ወደ እናንተ መጥቼ ወደ ይሁዳ በጉዞዬ እንድትረዱኝ አሰብሁ።

verses.en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
verses.fr: Dans cette persuasion, je voulais aller d''abord vers vous, afin que vous eussiez une double grâce;
verses.am: እንግዲህ ይህን ሳስብ ያን ጊዜ ቅሌትን አሳየሁን? ወይስ በእኔ ዘንድ አዎን አዎን አይደለም አይደለም ማለት እንዲሆን ያን የማስበው በዓለማዊ ልማድ ነውን?

verses.en: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
verses.fr: je voulais passer chez vous pour me rendre en Macédoine, puis revenir de la Macédoine chez vous, et vous m''auriez fait accompagner en Judée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን የታመነ ነው፥ ለእናንተም የሚነገረው ቃላችን አዎንና አይደለም አይሆንም።

verses.en: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
verses.fr: Est-ce que, en voulant cela, j''ai donc usé de légèreté? Ou bien, mes résolutions sont-elles des résolutions selon la chair, de sorte qu''il y ait en moi le oui et le non?
verses.am: በእኛ ማለት በእኔና በስልዋኖስ በጢሞቴዎስም በመካከላችሁ የተሰበከ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አዎንና አይደለም አልነበረም፥ ነገር ግን በእርሱ አዎን ሆኖአል።

verses.en: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
verses.fr: Aussi vrai que Dieu est fidèle, la parole que nous vous avons adressée n''a pas été oui et non.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለሰጠው የተስፋ ቃል ሁሉ አዎን ማለት በእርሱ ነውና፥ ስለዚህ ለእግዚአብሔር ስለ ክብሩ በእኛ የሚነገረው አሜን በእርሱ ደግሞ ነው።

verses.en: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
verses.fr: Car le Fils de Dieu, Jésus-Christ, qui a été prêché par nous au milieu de vous, par moi, et par Silvain, et par Timothée, n''a pas été oui et non, mais c''est oui qui a été en lui;
verses.am: በክርስቶስም ከእናንተ ጋር የሚያጸናንና የቀባን እግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.en: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
verses.fr: car, pour ce qui concerne toutes les promesses de Dieu, c''est en lui qu''est le oui; c''est pourquoi encore l''Amen par lui est prononcé par nous à la gloire de Dieu.
verses.am: ደግሞም ያተመን የመንፈሱንም መያዣ በልባችን የሰጠን እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
verses.fr: Et celui qui nous affermit avec vous en Christ, et qui nous a oints, c''est Dieu,
verses.am: እኔ ግን ልራራላችሁ ስል እንደ ገና ወደ ቆሮንቶስ እንዳልመጣሁ በነፍሴ ላይ እግዚአብሔርን ምስክር እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
verses.fr: lequel nous a aussi marqués d''un sceau et a mis dans nos coeurs les arrhes de l''Esprit.
verses.am: ለደስታችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር የምንሠራ ነን እንጂ፥ በእምነታችሁ በእናንተ ላይ የምንገዛ አይደለንም። በእምነታችሁ ቆማችኋልና።

verses.en: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
verses.fr: Or, je prends Dieu à témoin sur mon âme, que c''est pour vous épargner que je ne suis plus allé à Corinthe;
verses.am: እኔ ግን ልራራላችሁ ስል እንደ ገና ወደ ቆሮንቶስ እንዳልመጣሁ በነፍሴ ላይ እግዚአብሔርን ምስክር እጠራለሁ።

verses.en: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
verses.fr: non pas que nous dominions sur votre foi, mais nous contribuons à votre joie, car vous êtes fermes dans la foi.
verses.am: ለደስታችሁ ከእናንተ ጋር የምንሠራ ነን እንጂ፥ በእምነታችሁ በእናንተ ላይ የምንገዛ አይደለንም። በእምነታችሁ ቆማችኋልና።

verses.en: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
verses.fr: Je résolus donc en moi-même de ne pas retourner chez vous dans la tristesse.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ዳግመኛ በኀዘን ወደ እናንተ እንዳልመጣ ስለ እኔ ቆረጥሁ።

verses.en: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
verses.fr: Car si je vous attriste, qui peut me réjouir, sinon celui qui est attristé par moi?
verses.am: እኔስ ባሳዝናችሁ፥ እንግዲያስ በእኔ ምክንያት ከሚያዝን በቀር ደስ የሚያሰኘኝ ማን ነው?

verses.en: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
verses.fr: J''ai écrit comme je l''ai fait pour ne pas éprouver, à mon arrivée, de la tristesse de la part de ceux qui devaient me donner de la joie, ayant en vous tous cette confiance que ma joie est la vôtre à tous.
verses.am: ደስ ሊያሰኙኝ ከሚገባቸውም በመምጣቴ ኀዘን እንዳይሆንብኝ ይህንኑ ጻፍሁላችሁ፥ ደስታዬ የሁላችሁ ደስታ ነው ብዬ በሁላችሁ ታምኜአለሁና።

verses.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
verses.fr: C''est dans une grande affliction, le coeur angoissé, et avec beaucoup de larmes, que je vous ai écrit, non pas afin que vous fussiez attristés, mais afin que vous connussiez l''amour extrême que j''ai pour vous.
verses.am: በብዙ መከራና ከልብ ጭንቀት በብዙም እንባ ጽፌላችሁ ነበርና፤ ይህም እናንተን አብዝቼ የምወድበትን ፍቅር እንድታውቁ እንጂ እንዳሳዝናችሁ አይደለም።

verses.en: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un a été une cause de tristesse, ce n''est pas moi qu''il a attristé, c''est vous tous, du moins en partie, pour ne rien exagérer.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ማንም አሳዝኖ ቢሆን፥ እንዳልከብድባችሁ፥ በክፍል ሁላችሁን እንጂ እኔን ያሳዘነ አይደለም።

verses.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
verses.fr: Il suffit pour cet homme du châtiment qui lui a été infligé par le plus grand nombre,
verses.am: እንደዚህ ላለ ሰው ይህ ከእናንተ የምትበዙት የቀጣችሁት ቅጣት ይበቃዋልና እንደዚህ ያለው ከልክ በሚበዛ ኀዘን እንዳይዋጥ፥

verses.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
verses.fr: en sorte que vous devez bien plutôt lui pardonner et le consoler, de peur qu''il ne soit accablé par une tristesse excessive.
verses.am: ይልቅ ተመልሳችሁ ይቅር ማለትና ማጽናናት ይገባችኋል።

verses.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
verses.fr: Je vous exhorte donc à faire acte de charité envers lui;
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከእርሱ ጋር ፍቅርን እንድታጸኑ እለምናችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
verses.fr: car je vous ai écrit aussi dans le but de connaître, en vous mettant à l''épreuve, si vous êtes obéissants en toutes choses.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ጽፌ ነበርና፤ በሁሉ የምትታዘዙ እንደ ሆናችሁ የእናንተን መፈተን አውቅ ዘንድ አሳቤ ነበር።

verses.en: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
verses.fr: Or, à qui vous pardonnez, je pardonne aussi; et ce que j''ai pardonné, si j''ai pardonné quelque chose, c''est à cause de vous, en présence de Christ,
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ይቅር የምትሉትን እኔ ደግሞ ይቅር እለዋለሁ፤ እኔም ይቅር ካልሁ፥ ይቅር ያልሁትን ስለ እናንተ በክርስቶስ ፊት ይቅር ብዬአለሁ፥

verses.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
verses.fr: afin de ne pas laisser à Satan l''avantage sur nous, car nous n''ignorons pas ses desseins.
verses.am: በሰይጣን እንዳንታለል፤ የእርሱን አሳብ አንስተውምና።

verses.en: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
verses.fr: Au reste, lorsque je fus arrivé à Troas pour l''Evangile de Christ, quoique le Seigneur m''y eût ouvert une porte,
verses.am: ስለ ክርስቶስም ወንጌል ወደ ጢሮአዳ በመጣሁ ጊዜ፥ ለጌታ ሥራ በር ምንም ቢከፈትልኝ፥ ቲቶን ወንድሜን ስላላገኘሁት መንፈሴ ዕረፍት አልነበረውም፥

verses.en: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
verses.fr: je n''eus point de repos d''esprit, parce que je ne trouvai pas Tite, mon frère; c''est pourquoi, ayant pris congé d''eux, je partis pour la Macédoine.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእነርሱ ተሰናብቼ ወደ መቄዶንያ ወጣሁ።

verses.en: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
verses.fr: Grâces soient rendues à Dieu, qui nous fait toujours triompher en Christ, et qui répand par nous en tout lieu l''odeur de sa connaissance!
verses.am: ነገር ግን በክርስቶስ ሁልጊዜ ድል በመንሣቱ ለሚያዞረን በእኛም በየስፍራው ሁሉ የእውቀቱን ሽታ ለሚገልጥ ለአምላክ ምስጋና ይሁን፤

verses.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
verses.fr: Nous sommes, en effet, pour Dieu la bonne odeur de Christ, parmi ceux qui sont sauvés et parmi ceux qui périssent:
verses.am: በሚድኑቱና በሚጠፉቱ ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር የክርስቶስ መዓዛ ነንና፤

verses.en: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
verses.fr: aux uns, une odeur de mort, donnant la mort; aux autres, une odeur de vie, donnant la vie. Et qui est suffisant pour ces choses? -
verses.am: ለእነዚህ ለሞት የሚሆን የሞት ሽታ ለእነዚያም ለሕይወት የሚሆን የሕይወት ሽታ ነን። ለዚህም ነገር የሚበቃ ማን ነው?

verses.en: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
verses.fr: Car nous ne falsifions point la parole de Dieu, comme font plusieurs; mais c''est avec sincérité, mais c''est de la part de Dieu, que nous parlons en Christ devant Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ቀላቅለው እንደሚሸቃቅጡት እንደ ብዙዎቹ አይደለንምና፤ በቅንነት ግን ከእግዚአብሔር እንደ ተላክን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በክርስቶስ ሆነን እንናገራለን።

verses.en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
verses.fr: Commençons-nous de nouveau à nous recommander nous-mêmes? Ou avons-nous besoin, comme quelques-uns, de lettres de recommandation auprès de vous, ou de votre part?
verses.am: እንደ ገና ራሳችንን ልናመሰግን እንጀምራለንን? ወይስ እንደ ሌሎች የማመስገኛ መልእክት ወደ እናንተ ወይስ ከእናንተ ያስፈልገን ይሆንን?

verses.en: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verses.fr: C''est vous qui êtes notre lettre, écrite dans nos coeurs, connue et lue de tous les hommes.
verses.am: ሰዎች ሁሉ የሚያውቁትና የሚያነቡት በልባችን የተጻፈ መልእክታችን እናንተ ናችሁ።

verses.en: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
verses.fr: Vous êtes manifestement une lettre de Christ, écrite, par notre ministère, non avec de l''encre, mais avec l''Esprit du Dieu vivant, non sur des tables de pierre, mais sur des tables de chair, sur les coeurs.
verses.am: እናንተም በሕያው እግዚአብሔር መንፈስ እንጂ በቀለም አይደለም፥ ሥጋ በሆነ በልብ ጽላት እንጂ በድንጋይ ጽላት ያልተጻፈ፥ በእኛም የተገለገለ የክርስቶስ መልእክት እንደ ሆናችሁ የተገለጠ ነው።

verses.en: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
verses.fr: Cette assurance-là, nous l''avons par Christ auprès de Dieu.
verses.am: በክርስቶስም በኩል ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ያለ እምነት አለን።

verses.en: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas à dire que nous soyons par nous-mêmes capables de concevoir quelque chose comme venant de nous-mêmes. Notre capacité, au contraire, vient de Dieu.
verses.am: ብቃታችን ከእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ፥ በገዛ እጃችን እንደሚሆን አንዳችን እንኳ ልናስብ ራሳችን የበቃን አይደለንም፤

verses.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
verses.fr: Il nous a aussi rendus capables d''être ministres d''une nouvelle alliance, non de la lettre, mais de l''esprit; car la lettre tue, mais l''esprit vivifie.
verses.am: እርሱም ደግሞ በመንፈስ እንጂ በፊደል ለማይሆን ለአዲስ ኪዳን አገልጋዮች እንሆን ዘንድ አበቃን፤ ፊደል ይገድላልና መንፈስ ግን ሕይወትን ይሰጣል።

verses.en: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
verses.fr: Or, si le ministère de la mort, gravé avec des lettres sur des pierres, a été glorieux, au point que les fils d''Israël ne pouvaient fixer les regards sur le visage de Moïse, à cause de la gloire de son visage, bien que cette gloire fût passagère,
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን የእስራኤል ልጆች ስለዚያ ስለ ተሻረው ስለ ፊቱ ክብር የሙሴን ፊት ትኩር ብለው መመልከት እስኪሳናቸው ድረስ፥ ያ በፊደላት በድንጋዮች ላይ የተቀረጸ የሞት አገልግሎት በክብር ከሆነ፥

verses.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
verses.fr: combien le ministère de l''esprit ne sera-t-il pas plus glorieux!
verses.am: የመንፈስ አገልግሎት እንዴት ይልቅ በክብር አይሆንም?

verses.en: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
verses.fr: Si le ministère de la condamnation a été glorieux, le ministère de la justice est de beaucoup supérieur en gloire.
verses.am: የኵነኔ አገልግሎት ክብር ከሆነ፥ ይልቅ የጽድቅ አገልግሎት በክብር አብዝቶ ይበልጣልና።

verses.en: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
verses.fr: Et, sous ce rapport, ce qui a été glorieux ne l''a point été, à cause de cette gloire qui lui est supérieure.
verses.am: ያ የከበረ እንኳ እጅግ በሚበልጠው ክብር ምክንያት በዚህ ነገር ክብሩን አጥቶአልና።

verses.en: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
verses.fr: En effet, si ce qui était passager a été glorieux, ce qui est permanent est bien plus glorieux.
verses.am: ያ ይሻር የነበረው በክብር ከሆነ፥ ጸንቶ የሚኖረውማ እጅግ ይልቅ በክብር ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
verses.fr: Ayant donc cette espérance, nous usons d''une grande liberté,
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንዲህ ያለ ተስፋ ካለን እጅግ ገልጠን እንናገራለን፥

verses.en: And not as Moses, which put a veil over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
verses.fr: et nous ne faisons pas comme Moïse, qui mettait un voile sur son visage, pour que les fils d''Israël ne fixassent pas les regards sur la fin de ce qui était passager.
verses.am: የዚያንም ይሻር የነበረውን መጨረሻ ትኵር ብለው የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዳይመለከቱ፥ በፊቱ መጋረጃ እንዳደረገ እንደ ሙሴ አይደለንም።

verses.en: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
verses.fr: Mais ils sont devenus durs d''entendement. Car jusqu''à ce jour le même voile demeure quand, ils font la lecture de l''Ancien Testament, et il ne se lève pas, parce que c''est en Christ qu''il disparaît.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሳባቸው ደነዘዘ። ብሉይ ኪዳን ሲነበብ ያ መጋረጃ ሳይወሰድ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ይኖራልና፤ በክርስቶስ ብቻ የተሻረ ነውና።

verses.en: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à ce jour, quand on lit Moïse, un voile est jeté sur leurs coeurs;
verses.am: ነገር ግን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የሙሴ መጻሕፍት በተነበቡ ጊዜ ሁሉ ያ መጋረጃ በልባቸው ይኖራል፤

verses.en: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
verses.fr: mais lorsque les coeurs se convertissent au Seigneur, le voile est ôté.
verses.am: ወደ ጌታ ግን ዘወር ባለ ጊዜ ሁሉ መጋረጃው ይወሰዳል።

verses.en: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
verses.fr: Or, le Seigneur c''est l''Esprit; et là où est l''Esprit du Seigneur, là est la liberté.
verses.am: ጌታ ግን መንፈስ ነው፤ የጌታም መንፈስ ባለበት በዚያ አርነት አለ።

verses.en: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
verses.fr: Nous tous qui, le visage découvert, contemplons comme dans un miroir la gloire du Seigneur, nous sommes transformés en la même image, de gloire en gloire, comme par le Seigneur, l''Esprit.
verses.am: እኛም ሁላችን በመጋረጃ በማይከደን ፊት የጌታን ክብር እንደ መስተዋት እያብለጨለጭን መንፈስ ከሚሆን ጌታ እንደሚደረግ ያን መልክ እንመስል ዘንድ ከክብር ወደ ክብር እንለወጣለን።

verses.en: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, ayant ce ministère, selon la miséricorde qui nous a été faite, nous ne perdons pas courage.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምክንያት ምሕረት እንደ ተሰጠን መጠን ይህ አገልግሎት ስላለን አንታክትም።

verses.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
verses.fr: Nous rejetons les choses honteuses qui se font en secret, nous n''avons point une conduite astucieuse, et nous n''altérons point la parole de Dieu. Mais, en publiant la vérité, nous nous recommandons à toute conscience d''homme devant Dieu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሚያሳፍረውን ስውር ነገር ጥለናልና በተንኮል አንመላለስም የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል በውሸት አንቀላቅልም፤ እውነትን በመግለጥ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለሰው ሕሊና ሁሉ ራሳችንን እናመሰግናለን።

verses.en: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
verses.fr: Si notre Evangile est encore voilé, il est voilé pour ceux qui périssent;
verses.am: ወንጌላችን የተከደነ ቢሆን እንኳ የተከደነባቸው ለሚጠፉ ነው።

verses.en: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
verses.fr: pour les incrédules dont le dieu de ce siècle a aveuglé l''intelligence, afin qu''ils ne vissent pas briller la splendeur de l''Evangile de la gloire de Christ, qui est l''image de Dieu.
verses.am: ለእነርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ምሳሌ የሆነ የክርስቶስ የክብሩ ወንጌል ብርሃን እንዳያበራላቸው፥ የዚህ ዓለም አምላክ የማያምኑትን አሳብ አሳወረ።

verses.en: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
verses.fr: Nous ne nous prêchons pas nous-mêmes; c''est Jésus-Christ le Seigneur que nous prêchons, et nous nous disons vos serviteurs à cause de Jésus.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን ጌታ እንደ ሆነ እንጂ ራሳችንን አንሰብክምና፥ ስለ ኢየሱስም ራሳችንን ለእናንተ ባሪያዎች እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Car Dieu, qui a dit: La lumière brillera du sein des ténèbres! a fait briller la lumière dans nos coeurs pour faire resplendir la connaissance de la gloire de Dieu sur la face de Christ.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ፊት የእግዚአብሔርን የክብሩን እውቀት ብርሃን እንዲሰጥ በልባችን ውስጥ የበራ። በጨለማ ብርሃን ይብራ ያለ እግዚአብሔር ነውና።

verses.en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
verses.fr: Nous portons ce trésor dans des vases de terre, afin que cette grande puissance soit attribuée à Dieu, et non pas à nous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የኃይሉ ታላቅነት ከእግዚአብሔር እንጂ ከእኛ እንዳይሆን ይህ መዝገብ በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ አለን፤

verses.en: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
verses.fr: Nous sommes pressés de toute manière, mais non réduits à l''extrémité; dans la détresse, mais non dans le désespoir;
verses.am: በሁሉ እንገፋለን እንጂ አንጨነቅም፤ እናመነታለን እንጂ ተስፋ አንቆርጥም፤

verses.en: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
verses.fr: persécutés, mais non abandonnés; abattus, mais non perdus;
verses.am: እንሰደዳለን እንጂ አንጣልም፤ እንወድቃለን እንጂ አንጠፋም፤

verses.en: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
verses.fr: portant toujours avec nous dans notre corps la mort de Jésus, afin que la vie de Jésus soit aussi manifestée dans notre corps.
verses.am: የኢየሱስ ሕይወት ደግሞ በሥጋችን ይገለጥ ዘንድ ሁልጊዜ የኢየሱስን መሞት በሥጋችን ተሸክመን እንዞራለን።

verses.en: For we which live are always delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
verses.fr: Car nous qui vivons, nous sommes sans cesse livrés à la mort à cause de Jésus, afin que la vie de Jésus soit aussi manifestée dans notre chair mortelle.
verses.am: የኢየሱስ ሕይወት ደግሞ በሚሞት ሥጋችን ይገለጥ ዘንድ እኛ ሕያዋን የሆንን ከኢየሱስ የተነሣ ዘወትር ለሞት አልፈን እንሰጣለንና።

verses.en: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
verses.fr: Ainsi la mort agit en nous, et la vie agit en vous.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሞቱ በእኛ ሕይወቱም በእናንተ ይሠራል።

verses.en: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
verses.fr: Et, comme nous avons le même esprit de foi qui est exprimé dans cette parole de l''Ecriture: J''ai cru, c''est pourquoi j''ai parlé! nous aussi nous croyons, et c''est pour cela que nous parlons,
verses.am: ነገር ግን። አመንሁ ስለዚህም ተናገርሁ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ያው አንዱ የእምነት መንፈስ ስላለን፥ እኛ ደግሞ እናምናለን ስለዚህም እንናገራለን፤

verses.en: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
verses.fr: sachant que celui qui a ressuscité le Seigneur Jésus nous ressuscitera aussi avec Jésus, et nous fera paraître avec vous en sa présence.
verses.am: ጌታን ኢየሱስን ያስነሣው እኛን ደግሞ ከኢየሱስ ጋር እንዲያስነሣን ከእናንተም ጋር እንዲያቀርበን እናውቃለንና።

verses.en: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
verses.fr: Car tout cela arrive à cause de vous, afin que la grâce en se multipliant, fasse abonder, à la gloire de Dieu, les actions de grâces d''un plus grand nombre.
verses.am: በብዙዎች በኩል የተትረፈረፈው ጸጋ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር ምስጋናን ያበዛ ዘንድ፥ ሁሉ ስለ እናንተ ነውና።

verses.en: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi nous ne perdons pas courage. Et lors même que notre homme extérieur se détruit, notre homme intérieur se renouvelle de jour en jour.
verses.am: ስለዚህም አንታክትም፥ ነገር ግን የውጭው ሰውነታችን ቢጠፋ እንኳ የውስጡ ሰውነታችን ዕለት ዕለት ይታደሳል።

verses.en: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
verses.fr: Car nos légères afflictions du moment présent produisent pour nous, au delà de toute mesure, un poids éternel de gloire,

verses.en: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verses.fr: parce que nous regardons, non point aux choses visibles, mais à celles qui sont invisibles; car les choses visibles sont passagères, et les invisibles sont éternelles.
verses.am: የማይታየውን እንጂ የሚታየውን ባንመለከት፥ ቀላል የሆነ የጊዜው መከራችን የክብርን የዘላለም ብዛት ከሁሉ መጠን ይልቅ ያደርግልናልና፤ የሚታየው የጊዜው ነውና፥ የማይታየው ግን የዘላለም ነው።

verses.en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
verses.fr: Nous savons, en effet, que, si cette tente où nous habitons sur la terre est détruite, nous avons dans le ciel un édifice qui est l''ouvrage de Dieu, une demeure éternelle qui n''a pas été faite de main d''homme.
verses.am: ድንኳን የሚሆነው ምድራዊ መኖሪያችን ቢፈርስ፥ በሰማይ ያለ በእጅ ያልተሠራ የዘላለም ቤት የሚሆን ከእግዚአብሔር የተሠራ ሕንጻ እንዳለን እናውቃለንና።

verses.en: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
verses.fr: Aussi nous gémissons dans cette tente, désirant revêtir notre domicile céleste,
verses.am: በዚህ ውስጥ በእውነት እንቃትታለንና፥

verses.en: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
verses.fr: si du moins nous sommes trouvés vêtus et non pas nus.
verses.am: ከሰማይም የሚሆነውን መኖሪያችንን እንድንለብስ እንናፍቃለንና ለብሰን ራቁታችንን አንገኝም።

verses.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
verses.fr: Car tandis que nous sommes dans cette tente, nous gémissons, accablés, parce que nous voulons, non pas nous dépouiller, mais nous revêtir, afin que ce qui est mortel soit englouti par la vie.
verses.am: በእውነትም የሚሞተው በሕይወት ይዋጥ ዘንድ ልንለብስ እንጂ ልንገፈፍ የማንወድ ስለ ሆነ፥ በድንኳኑ ያለን እኛ ከብዶን እንቃትታለን።

verses.en: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
verses.fr: Et celui qui nous a formés pour cela, c''est Dieu, qui nous a donné les arrhes de l''Esprit.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለዚሁ የሠራን እግዚአብሔር ነው እርሱም የመንፈሱን መያዣ ሰጠን።

verses.en: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
verses.fr: Nous sommes donc toujours pleins de confiance, et nous savons qu''en demeurant dans ce corps nous demeurons loin du Seigneur-

verses.en: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
verses.fr: car nous marchons par la foi et non par la vue,
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሁልጊዜ ታምነን፥ በእምነት እንጂ በማየት አንመላለስምና በሥጋ ስናድር ከጌታ ተለይተን በስደት እንዳለን የምናውቅ ከሆንን፥

verses.en: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
verses.fr: nous sommes pleins de confiance, et nous aimons mieux quitter ce corps et demeurer auprès du Seigneur.
verses.am: ታምነናል ይልቁንም ከሥጋ ተለይተን በስደት መኖር በጌታም ዘንድ ማደር ደስ ይለናል።

verses.en: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
verses.fr: C''est pour cela aussi que nous nous efforçons de lui être agréables, soit que nous demeurions dans ce corps, soit que nous le quittions.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ ብናድር ወይም ተለይተን ብንሆን እርሱን ደስ የምናሰኝ ልንሆን እንቀናለን።

verses.en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
verses.fr: Car il nous faut tous comparaître devant le tribunal de Christ, afin que chacun reçoive selon le bien ou le mal qu''il aura fait, étant dans son corps.
verses.am: መልካም ቢሆን ወይም ክፉ እንዳደረገ፥ እያንዳንዱ በሥጋው የተሠራውን በብድራት ይቀበል ዘንድ ሁላችን በክርስቶስ በፍርድ ወንበር ፊት ልንገለጥ ይገባናልና።

verses.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
verses.fr: Connaissant donc la crainte du Seigneur, nous cherchons à convaincre les hommes; Dieu nous connaît, et j''espère que dans vos consciences vous nous connaissez aussi.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የጌታን ፍርሃት አውቀን ሰዎችን እናስረዳለን ለእግዚአብሔር ግን የተገለጥን ነን፤ በሕሊናችሁም ደግሞ የተገለጥን እንደ ሆንን ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
verses.fr: Nous ne nous recommandons pas de nouveau nous-mêmes auprès de vous; mais nous vous donnons occasion de vous glorifier à notre sujet, afin que vous puissiez répondre à ceux qui tirent gloire de ce qui est dans les apparences et non dans le coeur.
verses.am: በመልክ እንጂ በልብ ለማይመኩ የምትመልሱላቸው መልስ እንዲኖራችሁ፥ በእኛ ልትመኩ ምክንያት እንሰጣችኋለን እንጂ ራሳችንን ደግሞ ለእናንተ የምናመሰግን አይደለንም።

verses.en: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
verses.fr: En effet, si je suis hors de sens, c''est pour Dieu; si je suis de bon sens, c''est pour vous.
verses.am: እብዶች ብንሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ባለ አእምሮዎች ብንሆን፥ ለእናንተ ነው።

verses.en: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verses.fr: Car l''amour de Christ nous presse, parce que nous estimons que, si un seul est mort pour tous, tous donc sont morts;
verses.am: ይህን ስለቆረጥን የክርስቶስ ፍቅር ግድ ይለናልና፤ አንዱ ስለ ሁሉ ሞተ፤ እንግዲያስ ሁሉ ሞቱ፤

verses.en: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
verses.fr: et qu''il est mort pour tous, afin que ceux qui vivent ne vivent plus pour eux-mêmes, mais pour celui qui est mort et ressuscité pour eux.
verses.am: በሕይወትም ያሉት ስለ እነርሱ ለሞተውና ለተነሣው እንጂ ወደ ፊት ለራሳቸው እንዳይኖሩ ስለ ሁሉ ሞተ።

verses.en: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
verses.fr: Ainsi, dès maintenant, nous ne connaissons personne selon la chair; et si nous avons connu Christ selon la chair, maintenant nous ne le connaissons plus de cette manière.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እኛ ከአሁን ጀምሮ ማንንም በሥጋ እንደሚሆን አናውቅም፤ ክርስቶስንም በሥጋ እንደ ሆነ ያወቅነው ብንሆን እንኳ፥ አሁን ግን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንደዚህ አናውቀውም።

verses.en: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un est en Christ, il est une nouvelle créature. Les choses anciennes sont passées; voici, toutes choses sont devenues nouvelles.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ማንም በክርስቶስ ቢሆን አዲስ ፍጥረት ነው፤ አሮጌው ነገር አልፎአል፤ እነሆ፥ ሁሉም አዲስ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
verses.fr: Et tout cela vient de Dieu, qui nous a réconciliés avec lui par Christ, et qui nous a donné le ministère de la réconciliation.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሆነው ሁሉ፥ በክርስቶስ ከራሱ ጋር ካስታረቀን የማስታረቅም አገልግሎት ከሰጠን፥ ከእግዚአብሔር ነው፤

verses.en: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
verses.fr: Car Dieu était en Christ, réconciliant le monde avec lui-même, en n''imputant point aux hommes leurs offenses, et il a mis en nous la parole de la réconciliation.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በክርስቶስ ሆኖ ዓለሙን ከራሱ ጋር ያስታርቅ ነበርና፥ በደላቸውን አይቆጥርባቸውም ነበር፤ በእኛም የማስታረቅ ቃል አኖረ።

verses.en: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
verses.fr: Nous faisons donc les fonctions d''ambassadeurs pour Christ, comme si Dieu exhortait par nous; nous vous en supplions au nom de Christ: Soyez réconciliés avec Dieu!
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር በእኛ እንደሚማልድ ስለ ክርስቶስ መልክተኞች ነን፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ታረቁ ብለን ስለ ክርስቶስ እንለምናለን።

verses.en: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
verses.fr: Celui qui n''a point connu le péché, il l''a fait devenir péché pour nous, afin que nous devenions en lui justice de Dieu.
verses.am: እኛ በእርሱ ሆነን የእግዚአብሔር ጽድቅ እንሆን ዘንድ ኃጢአት ያላወቀውን እርሱን ስለ እኛ ኃጢአት አደረገው።

verses.en: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
verses.fr: Puisque nous travaillons avec Dieu, nous vous exhortons à ne pas recevoir la grâce de Dieu en vain.
verses.am: አብረንም እየሠራን የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ በከንቱ እንዳትቀበሉ ደግሞ እንለምናለን፤

verses.en: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
verses.fr: Car il dit: Au temps favorable je t''ai exaucé, Au jour du salut je t''ai secouru. Voici maintenant le temps favorable, voici maintenant le jour du salut.
verses.am: በተወደደ ሰዓት ሰማሁህ በመዳንም ቀን ረዳሁህ ይላልና፤ እነሆ፥ የተወደደው ሰዓት አሁን ነው፤ እነሆ፥ የመዳን ቀን አሁን ነው።

verses.en: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
verses.fr: Nous ne donnons aucun sujet de scandale en quoi que ce soit, afin que le ministère ne soit pas un objet de blâme.
verses.am: አገልግሎታችንም እንዳይነቀፍ በአንዳች ነገር ማሰናከያ ከቶ አንሰጥም።

verses.en: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
verses.fr: Mais nous nous rendons à tous égards recommandables, comme serviteurs de Dieu, par beaucoup de patience dans les tribulations, dans les calamités, dans les détresses,
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሁሉ እንደ እግዚአብሔር አገልጋዮች ራሳችንን እናማጥናለን፤

verses.en: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
verses.fr: sous les coups, dans les prisons, dans les troubles, dans les travaux, dans les veilles, dans les jeûnes;
verses.am: በብዙ መጽናት፥ በመከራ፥ በችግር፥ በጭንቀት፥ በመገረፍ፥ በወኅኒ፥ በሁከት፥ በድካም፥ እንቅልፍ በማጣት፥

verses.en: By pureness, by knowledge, by long suffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
verses.fr: par la pureté, par la connaissance, par la longanimité, par la bonté, par un esprit saint, par une charité sincère,
verses.am: በመጦም፥ በንጽህና፥ በእውቀት፥ በትዕግሥት፥ በቸርነት፥ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ፥ ግብዝነት በሌለው ፍቅር፥ በእውነት ቃል፥

verses.en: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.fr: par la parole de vérité, par la puissance de Dieu, par les armes offensives et défensives de la justice;
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ኃይል፥ ለቀኝና ለግራ በሚሆን በጽድቅ የጦር ዕቃ፥ በክብርና በውርደት፥

verses.en: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
verses.fr: au milieu de la gloire et de l''ignominie, au milieu de la mauvaise et de la bonne réputation; étant regardés comme imposteurs, quoique véridiques;
verses.am: በክፉ ወሬና በመልካም ወሬ ራሳችንን እናማጥናለን፤ አሳቾች ስንባል እውነተኞች ነን፤

verses.en: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
verses.fr: comme inconnus, quoique bien connus; comme mourants, et voici nous vivons; comme châtiés, quoique non mis à mort;
verses.am: ያልታወቁ ስንባል የታወቅን ነን፤ የምንሞት ስንመስል እነሆ ሕያዋን ነን፤ የተቀጣን ስንሆን አንገደልም፤

verses.en: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
verses.fr: comme attristés, et nous sommes toujours joyeux; comme pauvres, et nous en enrichissons plusieurs; comme n''ayant rien, et nous possédons toutes choses.
verses.am: ኀዘንተኞች ስንሆን ዘወትር ደስ ይለናል፤ ድሆች ስንሆን ብዙዎችን ባለ ጠጎች እናደርጋለን፤ አንዳች የሌለን ስንሆን ሁሉ የእኛ ነው።

verses.en: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
verses.fr: Notre bouche s''est ouverte pour vous, Corinthiens, notre coeur s''est élargi.
verses.am: እናንተ የቆሮንቶስ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ አፋችን ለእናንተ ተከፍቶአል ልባችንም ሰፍቶላችኋል፤

verses.en: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
verses.fr: Vous n''êtes point à l''étroit au dedans de nous; mais vos entrailles se sont rétrécies.
verses.am: በእኛ አልጠበባችሁም በሆዳችሁ ግን ጠቦባችኋል፤

verses.en: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
verses.fr: Rendez-nous la pareille, -je vous parle comme à mes enfants, -élargissez-vous aussi!
verses.am: ልጆቼ እንደ መሆናችሁ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ ብድራት መልሳችሁልን ተስፋፉ።

verses.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
verses.fr: Ne vous mettez pas avec les infidèles sous un joug étranger. Car quel rapport y a-t-il entre la justice et l''iniquité? ou qu''y a-t-il de commun entre la lumière et les ténèbres?
verses.am: ከማያምኑ ጋር በማይመች አካሄድ አትጠመዱ፤ ጽድቅ ከዓመፅ ጋር ምን ተካፋይነት አለውና? ብርሃንም ከጨለማ ጋር ምን ኅብረት አለው?

verses.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
verses.fr: Quel accord y a-t-il entre Christ et Bélial? ou quelle part a le fidèle avec l''infidèle?
verses.am: ክርስቶስስ ከቤልሆር ጋር ምን መስማማት አለው? ወይስ የሚያምን ከማያምን ጋር ምን ክፍል አለው?

verses.en: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.fr: Quel rapport y a-t-il entre le temple de Dieu et les idoles? Car nous sommes le temple du Dieu vivant, comme Dieu l''a dit: J''habiterai et je marcherai au milieu d''eux; je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront mon peuple.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስም ከጣዖት ጋር ምን መጋጠም አለው? እኛ የሕያው እግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ነንና እንዲሁም እግዚአብሔር ተናገረ እንዲህ ሲል። በእነርሱ እኖራለሁ በመካከላቸውም እመላለሳለሁ፥ አምላካቸውም እሆናለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝቤ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, Sortez du milieu d''eux, Et séparez-vous, dit le Seigneur; Ne touchez pas à ce qui est impur, Et je vous accueillerai.

verses.en: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
verses.fr: Je serai pour vous un père, Et vous serez pour moi des fils et des filles, Dit le Seigneur tout-puissant.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ጌታ። ከመካከላቸው ውጡና የተለያችሁ ሁኑ ርኵስንም አትንኩ ይላል፤ ሁሉንም የሚገዛ ጌታ። እኔም እቀበላችኋለሁ፥ ለእናንተም አባት እሆናለሁ እናንተም ለእኔ ወንድ ልጆችና ሴት ልጆች ትሆናላችሁ ይላል።

verses.en: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
verses.fr: Ayant donc de telles promesses, bien-aimés, purifions-nous de toute souillure de la chair et de l''esprit, en achevant notre sanctification dans la crainte de Dieu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ የዚህ ተስፋ ቃል ካለን፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፍርሃት ቅድስናን ፍጹም እያደረግን ሥጋንና መንፈስን ከሚያረክስ ሁሉ ራሳችንን እናንጻ።

verses.en: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
verses.fr: Donnez-nous une place dans vos coeurs! Nous n''avons fait tort à personne, nous n''avons ruiné personne, nous n''avons tiré du profit de personne.
verses.am: በልባችሁ ስፍራ አስፉልን፤ ማንንም አልበደልንም፥ ማንንም አላጠፋንም፥ ማንንም አላታለልንም።

verses.en: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas pour vous condamner que je parle de la sorte; car j''ai déjà dit que vous êtes dans nos coeurs à la vie et à la mort.
verses.am: ለኵነኔ አልልም፤ በአንድነት ለመሞትና በአንድነት ለመኖር በልባችን እንዳላችሁ አስቀድሜ ብዬአለሁና።

verses.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
verses.fr: J''ai une grande confiance en vous, j''ai tout sujet de me glorifier de vous; je suis rempli de consolation, je suis comblé de joie au milieu de toutes nos tribulations.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ እምነቴ ታላቅ ነው፥ በእናንተ ምክንያት ትምክህቴ ታላቅ ነው፤ መጽናናት ሞልቶብኛል፤ በመከራችን ሁሉ ደስታዬ ከመጠን ይልቅ ይበዛል።

verses.en: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
verses.fr: Car, depuis notre arrivée en Macédoine, notre chair n''eut aucun repos; nous étions affligés de toute manière: luttes au dehors, craintes au dedans.
verses.am: ወደ መቄዶንያም በመጣን ጊዜ፥ በሁሉ ነገር መከራን ተቀበልን እንጂ ሥጋችን ዕረፍት አልነበረውም፤ በውጭ ጠብ ነበረ፥ በውስጥ ፍርሃት ነበረ።

verses.en: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
verses.fr: Mais Dieu, qui console ceux qui sont abattus, nous a consolés par l''arrivée de Tite,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኀዘንተኞችን የሚያጽናና አምላክ በቲቶ መምጣት አጽናናን፤

verses.en: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
verses.fr: et non seulement par son arrivée, mais encore par la consolation que Tite lui-même ressentait à votre sujet: il nous a raconté votre ardent désir, vos larmes, votre zèle pour moi, en sorte que ma joie a été d''autant plus grande.
verses.am: በመምጣቱም ብቻ አይደለም ነገር ግን ናፍቆታችሁንና ልቅሶአችሁን ስለ እኔም ቅንዓታችሁን ሲናገረን በእናንተ ላይ በተጽናናበት መጽናናት ደግሞ ነው፤ ስለዚህም ከፊት ይልቅ ደስ አለን።

verses.en: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
verses.fr: Quoique je vous aie attristés par ma lettre, je ne m''en repens pas. Et, si je m''en suis repenti, -car je vois que cette lettre vous a attristés, bien que momentanément, -
verses.am: በመልእክቴ ያሳዘንኋችሁ ብሆን እንኳ አልጸጸትም፤ የተጸጸትሁ ብሆን እንኳ፥ ያ መልእክት ጥቂት ጊዜ ብቻ እንዳሳዘናችሁ አያለሁና አሁን ለንስሐ ስላዘናችሁ ደስ ብሎኛል እንጂ ስላዘናችሁ አይደለም፤

verses.en: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
verses.fr: je me réjouis à cette heure, non pas de ce que vous avez été attristés, mais de ce que votre tristesse vous a portés à la repentance; car vous avez été attristés selon Dieu, afin de ne recevoir de notre part aucun dommage.
verses.am: በምንም ከእኛ የተነሣ እንዳትጎዱ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ አዝናችኋልና።

verses.en: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
verses.fr: En effet, la tristesse selon Dieu produit une repentance à salut dont on ne se repent jamais, tandis que la tristesse du monde produit la mort.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የሆነ ኀዘን ጸጸት የሌለበትን፥ ወደ መዳንም የሚያደርሰውን ንስሐ ያደርጋልና፤ የዓለም ኀዘን ግን ሞትን ያመጣል።

verses.en: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
verses.fr: Et voici, cette même tristesse selon Dieu, quel empressement n''a-t-elle pas produit en vous! Quelle justification, quelle indignation, quelle crainte, quel désir ardent, quel zèle, quelle punition! Vous avez montré à tous égards que vous étiez purs dans cette affaire.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይህ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የሆነ ኀዘን እንዴት ያለ ትጋት፥ እንዴት ያለ መልስ፥ እንዴት ያለ ቁጣ፥ እንዴት ያለ ፍርሃት፥ እንዴት ያለ ናፍቆት፥ እንዴት ያለ ቅንዓት፥ እንዴት ያለ በቀል በመካከላችሁ አደረገ። በዚህ ነገር ንጹሐን እንደ ሆናችሁ በሁሉ አስረድታችኋል።

verses.en: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
verses.fr: Si donc je vous ai écrit, ce n''était ni à cause de celui qui a fait l''injure, ni à cause de celui qui l''a reçue; c''était afin que votre empressement pour nous fût manifesté parmi vous devant Dieu.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ የጻፍሁላችሁ ብሆን እንኳ፥ ስለ እኛ ያላችሁ ትጋታችሁ ከእናንተ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲገለጥ እንጂ፥ ስለ በዳዩ ወይም ስለ ተበዳዩ አልጻፍሁም። ስለዚህ ተጽናንተናል።

verses.en: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi nous avons été consolés. Mais, outre notre consolation, nous avons été réjouis beaucoup plus encore par la joie de Tite, dont l''esprit a été tranquillisé par vous tous.
verses.am: በመጽናናታችንም ስለ ቲቶ ደስታ አብልጦ ደስ አለን፥ መንፈሱ በሁላችሁ ዐርፎአልና፤

verses.en: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
verses.fr: Et si devant lui je me suis un peu glorifié à votre sujet, je n''en ai point eu de confusion; mais, comme nous vous avons toujours parlé selon la vérité, ce dont nous nous sommes glorifiés auprès de Tite s''est trouvé être aussi la vérité.
verses.am: ለእርሱ በምንም ስለ እናንተ የተመካሁ እንደ ሆነ አላፈርሁምና፥ ነገር ግን ሁሉን ለእናንተ በእውነት እንደ ተናገርን፥ እንደዚህ ደግሞ ትምክህታችን በቲቶ ፊት እውነት ሆነ።

verses.en: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
verses.fr: Il éprouve pour vous un redoublement d''affection, au souvenir de votre obéissance à tous, et de l''accueil que vous lui avez fait avec crainte et tremblement.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ እንዴት እንደተቀበላችሁት፥ የሁላችሁን መታዘዝ እያሰበ ፍቅሩ በእናንተ ላይ እጅግ በዝቶአል።

verses.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
verses.fr: Je me réjouis de pouvoir en toutes choses me confier en vous.
verses.am: በነገር ሁሉ ተማምኜባችኋለሁና ደስ ይለኛል።

verses.en: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
verses.fr: Nous vous faisons connaître, frères, la grâce de Dieu qui s''est manifestée dans les Eglises de la Macédoine.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ለመቄዶንያ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት የተሰጠውን የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ እናስታውቃችኋለን፤

verses.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
verses.fr: Au milieu de beaucoup de tribulations qui les ont éprouvées, leur joie débordante et leur pauvreté profonde ont produit avec abondance de riches libéralités de leur part.
verses.am: በብዙ መከራ ተፈትነው ሳሉ የደስታቸው ብዛትና የድህነታቸው ጥልቅነት የልግስናቸውን ባለ ጠግነት አብዝቶአል፤

verses.en: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
verses.fr: Ils ont, je l''atteste, donné volontairement selon leurs moyens, et même au delà de leurs moyens,
verses.am: እንደ ዓቅማቸው መጠን ከዓቅማቸውም የሚያልፍ እንኳ ወደው እንደ ሰጡ እመሰክርላቸዋለሁና።

verses.en: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
verses.fr: nous demandant avec de grandes instances la grâce de prendre part à l''assistance destinée aux saints.
verses.am: ለቅዱሳን በሆነው አገልግሎት እንዲተባበሩ ይህን ቸርነት በብዙ ልመና ከእኛ ይለምኑ ነበር፥

verses.en: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
verses.fr: Et non seulement ils ont contribué comme nous l''espérions, mais ils se sont d''abord donnés eux-mêmes au Seigneur, puis à nous, par la volonté de Dieu.
verses.am: አስቀድመውም በእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ራሳቸውን ለጌታ ለእኛም ሰጡ እንጂ እንዳሰብን አይደለም።

verses.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
verses.fr: Nous avons donc engagé Tite à achever chez vous cette oeuvre de bienfaisance, comme il l''avait commencée.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ቲቶ አስቀድሞ እንደ ጀመረ እንዲሁ ደግሞ ይህን ቸር ሥራ ደግሞ በእናንተ ዘንድ ሊፈጽም ለመንን።

verses.en: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
verses.fr: De même que vous excellez en toutes choses, en foi, en parole, en connaissance, en zèle à tous égards, et dans votre amour pour nous, faites en sorte d''exceller aussi dans cette oeuvre de bienfaisance.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በነገር ሁሉ፥ በእምነትና በቃል በእውቀትም በትጋትም ሁሉ ለእኛም በፍቅራችሁ እንደ ተረፋችሁ፥ በዚህ ቸር ሥራ ደግሞ ትረፉ።

verses.en: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
verses.fr: Je ne dis pas cela pour donner un ordre, mais pour éprouver, par le zèle des autres, la sincérité de votre charité.
verses.am: ትእዛዝ እንደምሰጥ አልልም፥ ነገር ግን በሌሎች ትጋት በኩል የፍቅራችሁን እውነተኛነት ደግሞ ልመረምር እላለሁ፤

verses.en: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
verses.fr: Car vous connaissez la grâce de notre Seigneur Jésus-Christ, qui pour vous s''est fait pauvre, de riche qu''il était, afin que par sa pauvreté vous fussiez enrichis.
verses.am: የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ቸር ስጦታ አውቃችኋልና፤ ሀብታም ሲሆን፥ እናንተ በእርሱ ድህነት ባለ ጠጎች ትሆኑ ዘንድ ስለ እናንተ ድሀ ሆነ።

verses.en: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
verses.fr: C''est un avis que je donne là-dessus, car cela vous convient, à vous qui non seulement avez commencé à agir, mais qui en avez eu la volonté dès l''année dernière.
verses.am: በዚህም ነገር ምክር እሰጣለሁ፤ ከአምና ጀምራችሁ ለማድረግ ብቻ ያይደለ ነገር ግን ለማሰብ ደግሞ አስቀድማችሁ የጀመራችሁት ይህ ይጠቅማችኋልና፤

verses.en: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
verses.fr: Achevez donc maintenant d''agir, afin que l''accomplissement selon vos moyens réponde à l''empressement que vous avez mis à vouloir.
verses.am: አሁንም ለማሰብ በጎ ፈቃድ እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ እንዳላችሁ መጠን መፈጸም ደግሞ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ ማድረጉን ደግሞ ፈጽሙ።

verses.en: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
verses.fr: La bonne volonté, quand elle existe, est agréable en raison de ce qu''elle peut avoir à sa disposition, et non de ce qu''elle n''a pas.
verses.am: በጎ ፈቃድ ቢኖር፥ እንዳለው መጠን የተወደደ ይሆናል እንጂ እንደሌለው መጠን አይደለም።

verses.en: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
verses.fr: Car il s''agit, non de vous exposer à la détresse pour soulager les autres,
verses.am: ለሌሎች ዕረፍት ለእናንተም መከራ እንዲሆን አይደለም፥ ትክክል እንዲሆን ነው እንጂ፤

verses.en: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
verses.fr: mais de suivre une règle d''égalité: dans la circonstance présente votre superflu pourvoira à leurs besoins, afin que leur superflu pourvoie pareillement aux vôtres, en sorte qu''il y ait égalité,
verses.am: የእነርሱ ትርፍ ደግሞ የእናንተን ጉድለት እንዲሞላ በአሁኑ ጊዜ የእናንተ ትርፍ የእነርሱን ጉድለት ይሙላ፤ በትክክል እንዲሆን፥ እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ።

verses.en: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: Celui qui avait ramassé beaucoup n''avait rien de trop, et celui qui avait ramassé peu n''en manquait pas.
verses.am: ብዙ ያከማቸ አላተረፈም፥ ጥቂትም ያከማቸ አላጎደለም።

verses.en: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
verses.fr: Grâces soient rendues à Dieu de ce qu''il a mis dans le coeur de Tite le même empressement pour vous;
verses.am: ነገር ግን በቲቶ ልብ ስለ እናንተ ያንን ትጋት የሰጠ አምላክ ይመስገን፤

verses.en: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
verses.fr: car il a accueilli notre demande, et c''est avec un nouveau zèle et de son plein gré qu''il part pour aller chez vous.
verses.am: ምክራችንን ተቀብሎአልና፥ ትጋት ግን ስለ በዛበት ወዶ ወደ እናንተ ይወጣል።

verses.en: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
verses.fr: Nous envoyons avec lui le frère dont la louange en ce qui concerne l''Evangile est répandue dans toutes les Eglises,
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ስለ ወንጌል ስብከት በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ሁሉ የተመሰገነውን ወንድም እንልካለን፤

verses.en: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
verses.fr: et qui, de plus, a été choisi par les Eglises pour être notre compagnon de voyage dans cette oeuvre de bienfaisance, que nous accomplissons à la gloire du Seigneur même et en témoignage de notre bonne volonté.
verses.am: ይህም ብቻ አይደለም ነገር ግን የጌታን የራሱን ክብርና የእኛን በጎ ፈቃድ ለማሳየት በምናገለግለው በዚህ ቸር ሥራ ከእኛ ጋር እንዲጓደድ በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ደግሞ ተመረጠ።

verses.en: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
verses.fr: Nous agissons ainsi, afin que personne ne nous blâme au sujet de cette abondante collecte, à laquelle nous donnons nos soins;
verses.am: ስለምናገለግለው ስለዚህ ለጋስ ስጦታ ማንም እንዳይነቅፈን እንጠነቀቃለን፤

verses.en: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.fr: car nous recherchons ce qui est bien, non seulement devant le Seigneur, mais aussi devant les hommes.
verses.am: በጌታ ፊት ብቻ ያይደለ ነገር ግን በሰው ፊት ደግሞ መልካም የሆነውን እናስባለንና።

verses.en: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
verses.fr: Nous envoyons avec eux notre frère, dont nous avons souvent éprouvé le zèle dans beaucoup d''occasions, et qui en montre plus encore cette fois à cause de sa grande confiance en vous.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜም በብዙ ነገር መርምረን ትጉ እንደ ሆነ ያገኘነውን፥ አሁንም በእናንተ እጅግ ስለሚታመን ከፊት ይልቅ እጅግ ትጉ የሚሆነውን ወንድማችንን ከእነርሱ ጋር እንልካለን።

verses.en: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
verses.fr: Ainsi, pour ce qui est de Tite, il est notre associé et notre compagnon d''oeuvre auprès de vous; et pour ce qui est de nos frères, ils sont les envoyés des Eglises, la gloire de Christ.
verses.am: ስለ ቲቶ የሚጠይቅ ቢኖር ስለ እናንተ አብሮኝ የሚሠራ ባልንጀራዬ ነው፤ ስለ ወንድሞቻችን የሚጠይቅ ቢኖርም የአብያተ ክርስቲያናት መልእክተኞችና የክርስቶስ ክብር ናቸው።

verses.en: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.fr: Donnez-leur donc, à la face des Eglises, la preuve de votre charité, et montrez-leur que nous avons sujet de nous glorifier de vous.
verses.am: እንግዲህ የፍቅራችሁንና ስለ እናንተ ያለውን የትምክህታችንን መግለጫ በአብያተ ክርስቲያናት ፊት ለእነርሱ ግለጡ።

verses.en: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
verses.fr: Il est superflu que je vous écrive touchant l''assistance destinée aux saints.
verses.am: ለቅዱሳን ስለሚሆነው አገልግሎት ልጽፍላችሁ አያስፈልግምና፤

verses.en: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
verses.fr: Je connais, en effet, votre bonne volonté, dont je me glorifie pour vous auprès des Macédoniens, en déclarant que l''Achaïe est prête depuis l''année dernière; et ce zèle de votre part a stimulé le plus grand nombre.
verses.am: በጎ ፈቃዳችሁን አውቄአለሁና፤ ስለዚህም። አካይያ ከአምና ጀምሮ ተዘጋጅቶአል ብዬ ለመቄዶንያ ሰዎች በእናንተ እመካለሁ፥ ቅንዓታችሁም የሚበዙቱን አነሣሥቶአል።

verses.en: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
verses.fr: J''envoie les frères, afin que l''éloge que nous avons fait de vous ne soit pas réduit à néant sur ce point-là, et que vous soyez prêts, comme je l''ai dit.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእነርሱ እንዳልሁ፥ የተዘጋጃችሁ ትሆኑ ዘንድ በዚህም ነገር ስለ እናንተ ያለው ትምክህታችን ከንቱ እንዳይሆን ወንድሞችን እልካለሁ፤

verses.en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
verses.fr: Je ne voudrais pas, si les Macédoniens m''accompagnent et ne vous trouvent pas prêts, que cette assurance tournât à notre confusion, pour ne pas dire à la vôtre.
verses.am: ምናልባት የመቄዶንያ ሰዎች ከእኔ ጋር ቢመጡ፥ ያልተዘጋጃችሁም ሆናችሁ ቢያገኙአችሁ፥ እናንተ እንድታፍሩ አላልንም እኛ ግን በዚህ እምነታችን እንድናፍር አይሁን።

verses.en: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
verses.fr: J''ai donc jugé nécessaire d''inviter les frères à se rendre auparavant chez vous, et à s''occuper de votre libéralité déjà promise, afin qu''elle soit prête, de manière à être une libéralité, et non un acte d''avarice.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደ በረከት ሆኖ ከስስት የማይሆን ይህ የተዘጋጀ ይሆን ዘንድ አስቀድመው ወደ እናንተ መጥተው፥ አስቀድማችሁ ተስፋ የሰጣችሁትን በረከት አስቀድመው እንዲፈጽሙ ወንድሞችን እለምን ዘንድ እንዲያስፈልገኝ አሰብሁ።

verses.en: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
verses.fr: Sachez-le, celui qui sème peu moissonnera peu, et celui qui sème abondamment moissonnera abondamment.
verses.am: ይህንም እላለሁ። በጥቂት የሚዘራ በጥቂት ደግሞ ያጭዳል፥ በበረከትም የሚዘራ በበረከት ደግሞ ያጭዳል።

verses.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
verses.fr: Que chacun donne comme il l''a résolu en son coeur, sans tristesse ni contrainte; car Dieu aime celui qui donne avec joie.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በደስታ የሚሰጠውን ይወዳልና እያንዳንዱ በልቡ እንዳሰበ ይስጥ፥ በኀዘን ወይም በግድ አይደለም።

verses.en: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
verses.fr: Et Dieu peut vous combler de toutes sortes de grâces, afin que, possédant toujours en toutes choses de quoi satisfaire à tous vos besoins, vous ayez encore en abondance pour toute bonne oeuvre,

verses.en: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
verses.fr: selon qu''il est écrit: Il a fait des largesses, il a donné aux indigents; Sa justice subsiste à jamais.
verses.am: በተነ፥ ለምስኪኖች ሰጠ፥ ጽድቁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እግዚአብሔር፥ ሁልጊዜ በነገር ሁሉ ብቃትን ሁሉ አግኝታችሁ ለበጎ ሥራ ሁሉ ትበዙ ዘንድ፥ ጸጋን ሁሉ ሊያበዛላችሁ ይችላል።

verses.en: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
verses.fr: Celui qui Fournit de la semence au semeur, Et du pain pour sa nourriture, vous fournira et vous multipliera la semence, et il augmentera les fruits de votre justice.
verses.am: ለዘሪ ዘርን ለመብላትም እንጀራን በብዙ የሚሰጥ እርሱም የምትዘሩትን ዘር ይሰጣችኋል ያበረክትላችሁማል፥ የጽድቃችሁንም ፍሬ ያሳድጋል፤

verses.en: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
verses.fr: Vous serez de la sorte enrichis à tous égards pour toute espèce de libéralités qui, par notre moyen, feront offrir à Dieu des actions de grâces.
verses.am: በእኛ በኩል ለእግዚአብሔር የምስጋና ምክንያት የሚሆነውን ልግስና ሁሉ እንድታሳዩ በሁሉ ነገር ባለ ጠጎች ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
verses.fr: Car le secours de cette assistance non seulement pourvoit aux besoins des saints, mais il est encore une source abondante de nombreuses actions de grâces envers Dieu.
verses.am: የዚህ ረድኤት አገልግሎት ለቅዱሳን የሚጎድላቸውን በሙሉ የሚሰጥ ብቻ አይደለምና፥ ነገር ግን ደግሞ በብዙ ምስጋና ለእግዚአብሔር ይበዛል፤

verses.en: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
verses.fr: En considération de ce secours dont ils font l''expérience, ils glorifient Dieu de votre obéissance dans la profession de l''Evangile de Christ, et de la libéralité de vos dons envers eux et envers tous;
verses.am: በዚህ አገልግሎት ስለ ተፈተናችሁ፥ በክርስቶስ ወንጌል በማመናችሁ ስለሚሆን መታዘዝ እነርሱንና ሁሉንም ስለምትረዱበት ልግስና እግዚአብሔርን ያከብራሉ፥

verses.en: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
verses.fr: ils prient pour vous, parce qu''ils vous aiment à cause de la grâce éminente que Dieu vous a faite.
verses.am: ራሳቸውም ስለ እናንተ ሲያማልዱ፥ በእናንተ ላይ ከሚሆነው ከሚበልጠው ከእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ የተነሣ ይናፍቁአችኋል።

verses.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
verses.fr: Grâces soient rendues à Dieu pour son don ineffable!
verses.am: ስለማይነገር ስጦታው እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን።

verses.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
verses.fr: Moi Paul, je vous prie, par la douceur et la bonté de Christ, -moi, humble d''apparence quand je suis au milieu de vous, et plein de hardiesse à votre égard quand je suis éloigné, -
verses.am: እኔም ራሴ ጳውሎስ፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ ፊት ለፊት ሳለሁ ትሑት የሆንሁ፥ ከእናንተ ግን ብርቅ የምደፍራችሁ፥ በክርስቶስ የዋህነትና ገርነት እመክራችኋለሁ፤

verses.en: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.fr: je vous prie, lorsque je serai présent, de ne pas me forcer à recourir avec assurance à cette hardiesse, dont je me propose d''user contre quelques-uns qui nous regardent comme marchant selon la chair.
verses.am: በዓለማዊ ልማድ እንደምንመላለስ በሚቆጥሩን በአንዳንዶች ላይ አምኜ ልደፍር አስባለሁ፥ በዚያ እምነት ግን ከእናንተ ጋር ሆኜ እንዳልደፍር እለምንችኋለሁ።

verses.en: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
verses.fr: Si nous marchons dans la chair, nous ne combattons pas selon la chair.
verses.am: በሰው ልማድ ምንም እንኳ የምንመላለስ ብንሆን፥ እንደ ሰው ልማድ አንዋጋም፤

verses.en: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
verses.fr: Car les armes avec lesquelles nous combattons ne sont pas charnelles; mais elles sont puissantes, par la vertu de Dieu, pour renverser des forteresses.
verses.am: የጦር ዕቃችን ሥጋዊ አይደለምና፥ ምሽግን ለመስበር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ብርቱ ነው፤

verses.en: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verses.fr: Nous renversons les raisonnements et toute hauteur qui s''élève contre la connaissance de Dieu, et nous amenons toute pensée captive à l''obéissance de Christ.
verses.am: የሰውንም አሳብ በእግዚአብሔርም እውቀት ላይ የሚነሣውን ከፍ ያለውን ነገር ሁሉ እናፈርሳለን ለክርስቶስም ለመታዘዝ አእምሮን ሁሉ እንማርካለን፥

verses.en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.fr: Nous sommes prêts aussi à punir toute désobéissance, lorsque votre obéissance sera complète.
verses.am: መታዘዛችሁም በተፈጸመች ጊዜ አለመታዘዝን ሁሉ ልንበቀል ተዘጋጅተናል።

verses.en: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? if any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
verses.fr: Vous regardez à l''apparence! Si quelqu''un se persuade qu''il est de Christ, qu''il se dise bien en lui-même que, comme il est de Christ, nous aussi nous sommes de Christ.
verses.am: በፊታችሁ ያለውን ተመልከቱ። ማንም የክርስቶስ መሆኑን ተረድቶ ቢሆን፥ ይህን እንደ ገና በራሱ ይቁጠረው፤ እርሱ የክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ እኛ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ነን።

verses.en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
verses.fr: Et quand même je me glorifierais un peu trop de l''autorité que le Seigneur nous a donnée pour votre édification et non pour votre destruction, je ne saurais en avoir honte,
verses.am: ጌታ እናንተን ለማነጽ እንጂ እናንተን ለማፍረስ ያይደለ በሰጠው በሥልጣናችን ከፊት ይልቅ ብመካ እንኳ አላፍርም።

verses.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
verses.fr: afin que je ne paraisse pas vouloir vous intimider par mes lettres.
verses.am: በመልእክቶቼ የማስደነግጣችሁ አይምሰላችሁ።

verses.en: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
verses.fr: Car, dit-on, ses lettres sont sévères et fortes; mais, présent en personne, il est faible, et sa parole est méprisable.
verses.am: መልእክቶቹስ ከባድና ኃይለኛ ናቸው፥ ሰውነቱ ግን ሲታይ ደካማ ነው፥ ንግግሩም የተናቀ ነው ይላሉና።

verses.en: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
verses.fr: Que celui qui parle de la sorte considère que tels nous sommes en paroles dans nos lettres, étant absents, tels aussi nous sommes dans nos actes, étant présents.
verses.am: እንዲሁ የሚል ይህን ይቁጠረው፤ በሩቅ ሳለን በመልእክታችን በኩል በቃል እንዳለን፥ በፊቱ ደግሞ ሳለን በሥራ እንዲሁ ነን።

verses.en: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
verses.fr: Nous n''osons pas nous égaler ou nous comparer à quelques-uns de ceux qui se recommandent eux-mêmes. Mais, en se mesurant à leur propre mesure et en se comparant à eux-mêmes, ils manquent d''intelligence.
verses.am: ራሳቸውን ከሚያመሰግኑ ከአንዳንዶች ጋር ራሳችንን ልንቆጥር ወይም ራሳችንን ልናስተያይ አንደፍርምና፤ ነገር ግን እነርሱ ራሳቸውን ከራሳቸው ጋር ሲያመዛዝኑ፥ ራሳቸውንም ከራሳቸው ጋር ሲያስተያዩ፥ አያስተውሉም።

verses.en: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
verses.fr: Pour nous, nous ne voulons pas nous glorifier hors de toute mesure; nous prendrons, au contraire, pour mesure les limites du partage que Dieu nous a assigné, de manière à nous faire venir aussi jusqu''à vous.
verses.am: እኛ ግን እግዚአብሔር እንደ ወሰነልን እስከ እናንተ እንኳ እንደሚደርስ እንደ ክፍላችን ልክ እንጂ ያለ ልክ አንመካም።

verses.en: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
verses.fr: Nous ne dépassons point nos limites, comme si nous n''étions pas venus jusqu''à vous; car c''est bien jusqu''à vous que nous sommes arrivés avec l''Evangile de Christ.
verses.am: ወደ እናንተ እንደማንደርስ አድርገን ከመጠን አናልፍምና፥ የክርስቶስን ወንጌል በመስበክ እስከ እናንተ እንኳ ደርሰናልና፤

verses.en: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas hors de toute mesure, ce n''est pas des travaux d''autrui, que nous nous glorifions; mais c''est avec l''espérance, si votre foi augmente, de grandir encore d''avantage parmi vous, selon les limites qui nous sont assignées,

verses.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
verses.fr: et d''annoncer l''Evangile au delà de chez vous, sans nous glorifier de ce qui a été fait dans les limites assignées à d''autres.
verses.am: በሌሎች ድካም ያለ ልክ አንመካም፥ ነገር ግን እምነታችሁ ሲያድግ ከእናንተ ወዲያ ባለው አገር እስክንሰብክ ሥራችንን እየጨመርን፥ በክፍላችን በእናንተ ዘንድ እንድንከብር ተስፋ እናደርጋለን፤ በሌላው ክፍል ስለ ተዘጋጀው ነገር አንመካም።

verses.en: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.fr: Que celui qui se glorifie se glorifie dans le Seigneur.

verses.en: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
verses.fr: Car ce n''est pas celui qui se recommande lui-même qui est approuvé, c''est celui que le Seigneur recommande.
verses.am: የሚመካ ግን በጌታ ይመካ፤ እግዚአብሔር የሚያመሰግነው እንጂ ራሱን የሚያመሰግን እርሱ ተፈትኖ የሚወጣ አይደለምና።

verses.en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
verses.fr: Oh! si vous pouviez supporter de ma part un peu de folie! Mais vous, me supportez!
verses.am: በጥቂቱ ሞኝነቴ ብትታገሡኝ መልካም ይሆን ነበር፤ ቢሆንም በእርግጥ ታገሡኝ።

verses.en: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
verses.fr: Car je suis jaloux de vous d''une jalousie de Dieu, parce que je vous ai fiancés à un seul époux, pour vous présenter à Christ comme une vierge pure.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ቅንዓት እቀናላችኋለሁና፥ እንደ ንጽሕት ድንግል እናንተን ለክርስቶስ ላቀርብ ለአንድ ወንድ አጭቻችኋለሁና፤

verses.en: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
verses.fr: Toutefois, de même que le serpent séduisit Eve par sa ruse, je crains que vos pensées ne se corrompent et ne se détournent de la simplicité à l''égard de Christ.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እባብ በተንኮሉ ሔዋንን እንዳሳታት፥ አሳባችሁ ተበላሽቶ ለክርስቶስ ከሚሆን ቅንነትና ንጽሕና ምናልባት እንዳይለወጥ ብዬ እፈራለሁ።

verses.en: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
verses.fr: Car, si quelqu''un vient vous prêcher un autre Jésus que celui que nous avons prêché, ou si vous recevez un autre Esprit que celui que vous avez reçu, ou un autre Evangile que celui que vous avez embrassé, vous le supportez fort bien.
verses.am: የሚመጣውም ያልሰበክነውን ሌላ ኢየሱስ ቢሰብክ፥ ወይም ያላገኛችሁትን ልዩ መንፈስ ወይም ያልተቀበላችሁትን ልዩ ወንጌል ብታገኙ፥ በመልካም ትታገሡታላችሁ።

verses.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
verses.fr: Or, j''estime que je n''ai été inférieur en rien à ces apôtres par excellence.
verses.am: ከእነዚህ ከዋነኞቹ ሐዋርያት በአንድ ነገር እንኳ እንደ ጎደልሁ ራሴን አልቆጥርም።

verses.en: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
verses.fr: Si je suis un ignorant sous le rapport du langage, je ne le suis point sous celui de la connaissance, et nous l''avons montré parmi vous à tous égards et en toutes choses.
verses.am: በአነጋገሬ ያልተማርሁ ብሆን እንኳ፥ በእውቀት ግን እንዲህ አይደለሁም። ነገር ግን በሰው ሁሉ መካከል በነገር ሁሉ ተገልጠንላችኋል።

verses.en: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
verses.fr: Ou bien, ai-je commis un péché parce que, m''abaissant moi-même afin que vous fussiez élevés, je vous ai annoncé gratuitement l''Evangile de Dieu?
verses.am: ወይስ የእግዚአብሔርን ወንጌል ያለ ደመወዝ ስለ ሰበክሁላችሁ፥ እናንተ ከፍ እንድትሉ ራሴን እያዋረድሁ ኃጢአት አድርጌ ይሆንን?

verses.en: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
verses.fr: J''ai dépouillé d''autres Eglises, en recevant d''elles un salaire, pour vous servir.
verses.am: እናንተን ለማገልገል ደመወዝ እየተቀበልሁ ሌሎችን አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ዘረፍሁ።

verses.en: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
verses.fr: Et lorsque j''étais chez vous et que je me suis trouvé dans le besoin, je n''ai été à charge à personne; car les frères venus de Macédoine ont pourvu à ce qui me manquait. En toutes choses je me suis gardé de vous être à charge, et je m''en garderai.
verses.am: ከእናንተም ጋር ሳለሁ በጎደለኝ ጊዜ፥ በማንም አልከበድሁበትም፤ ከመቄዶንያ የመጡት ወንድሞች የጎደለኝን በሙሉ ሰጥተዋልና፤ በነገርም ሁሉ እንዳልከብድባችሁ ተጠነቀቅሁ እጠነቀቅማለሁ።

verses.en: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.fr: Par la vérité de Christ qui est en moi, je déclare que ce sujet de gloire ne me sera pas enlevé dans les contrées de l''Achaïe.
verses.am: የክርስቶስ እውነት በእኔ እንዳለ፥ ይህ ትምክህት በእኔ ዘንድ በአካይያ አገር አይከለከልም።

verses.en: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
verses.fr: Pourquoi?... Parce que je ne vous aime pas?... Dieu le sait!
verses.am: ስለ ምን? ስለማልወዳችሁ ነውን? እግዚአብሔር ያውቃል።

verses.en: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
verses.fr: Mais j''agis et j''agirai de la sorte, pour ôter ce prétexte à ceux qui cherchent un prétexte, afin qu''ils soient trouvés tels que nous dans les choses dont ils se glorifient.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዚያ በሚመኩበት እንደ እኛ ሆነው ሊገኙ፥ ምክንያትን ከሚፈልጉቱ ምክንያትን እቆርጥ ዘንድ አሁን የማደርገውን ከዚህ ወዲህ ደግሞ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
verses.fr: Ces hommes-là sont de faux apôtres, des ouvriers trompeurs, déguisés en apôtres de Christ.
verses.am: እንደ እነዚህ ያሉ ሰዎች የክርስቶስን ሐዋርያት እንዲመስሉ ራሳቸውን እየለወጡ፥ ውሸተኞች ሐዋርያትና ተንኮለኞች ሠራተኞች ናቸውና።

verses.en: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
verses.fr: Et cela n''est pas étonnant, puisque Satan lui-même se déguise en ange de lumière.
verses.am: ይህም ድንቅ አይደለም፤ ሰይጣን ራሱ የብርሃንን መልአክ እንዲመስል ራሱን ይለውጣልና።

verses.en: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
verses.fr: Il n''est donc pas étrange que ses ministres aussi se déguisent en ministres de justice. Leur fin sera selon leurs oeuvres.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አገልጋዮቹ ደግሞ የጽድቅን አገልጋዮች እንዲመስሉ ራሳቸውን ቢለውጡ ታላቅ ነገር አይደለም፤ ፍጻሜአቸውም እንደ ሥራቸው ይሆናል።

verses.en: I say again, let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
verses.fr: Je le répète, que personne ne me regarde comme un insensé; sinon, recevez-moi comme un insensé, afin que moi aussi, je me glorifie un peu.
verses.am: እንደ ገና እላለሁ። ለማንም ሰው ሞኝ የሆንሁ አይምሰለው፤ ያለዚያ ግን እኔ ደግሞ ጥቂት እመካ ዘንድ እንደ ሞኝ እንኳ ሆኜ ተቀበሉኝ።

verses.en: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.fr: Ce que je dis, avec l''assurance d''avoir sujet de me glorifier, je ne le dis pas selon le Seigneur, mais comme par folie.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ታምኜ ስመካ የምናገረው፥ በሞኝነት እንጂ ጌታ እንዳዘዘኝ አልናገርም።

verses.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
verses.fr: Puisqu''il en est plusieurs qui se glorifient selon la chair, je me glorifierai aussi.
verses.am: ብዙዎች በዓለማዊ ነገር ስለሚመኩ እኔ ደግሞ እመካለሁ።

verses.en: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
verses.fr: Car vous supportez volontiers les insensés, vous qui êtes sages.
verses.am: ልባሞች ስለምትሆኑ በደስታ ሞኞችን ትታገሣላችሁና፤

verses.en: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un vous asservit, si quelqu''un vous dévore, si quelqu''un s''empare de vous, si quelqu''un est arrogant, si quelqu''un vous frappe au visage, vous le supportez.
verses.am: ማንም ባሪያዎች ቢያደርጋችሁ፥ ማንም ቢበላችሁ፥ ማንም ቢቀማችሁ፥ ማንም ቢኮራባችሁ፥ ማንም ፊታችሁን በጥፊ ቢመታችሁ ትታገሣላችሁና።

verses.en: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
verses.fr: J''ai honte de le dire, nous avons montré de la faiblesse. Cependant, tout ce que peut oser quelqu''un, -je parle en insensé, -moi aussi, je l''ose!
verses.am: ደካሞች መስለን እንደ ነበርን በውርደት እላለሁ። ነገር ግን በሞኝነት እላለሁ፤ ማንም በሚደፍርበት እኔ ደግሞ እደፍርበታለሁ።

verses.en: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
verses.fr: Sont-ils Hébreux? Moi aussi. Sont-ils Israélites? Moi aussi. Sont-ils de la postérité d''Abraham? Moi aussi.
verses.am: ዕብራውያን ናቸውን? እኔ ደግሞ ነኝ። የእስራኤል ወገን ናቸውን? እኔ ደግሞ ነኝ። የአብርሃም ዘር ናቸውን? እኔ ደግሞ ነኝ። የክርስቶስ አገልጋዮች ናቸውን?

verses.en: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
verses.fr: Sont-ils ministres de Christ? -Je parle en homme qui extravague. -Je le suis plus encore: par les travaux, bien plus; par les coups, bien plus; par les emprisonnements, bien plus. Souvent en danger de mort,
verses.am: እንደ እብድ ሰው እላለሁ፤ እኔ እበልጣለሁ፤ በድካም አብዝቼ፥ በመገረፍ አብዝቼ፥ በመታሰር አትርፌ፥ በመሞት ብዙ ጊዜ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
verses.fr: cinq fois j''ai reçu des Juifs quarante coups moins un,
verses.am: አይሁድ አንድ ሲጎድል አርባ ግርፋት አምስት ጊዜ ገረፉኝ።

verses.en: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verses.fr: trois fois j''ai été battu de verges, une fois j''ai été lapidé, trois fois j''ai fait naufrage, j''ai passé un jour et une nuit dans l''abîme.
verses.am: ሦስት ጊዜ በበትር ተመታሁ፤ አንድ ጊዜ በድንጋይ ተወገርሁ፤ መርከቤ ሦስት ጊዜ ተሰበረ፤ ሌሊትና ቀን በባሕር ውስጥ ኖርሁ።

verses.en: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
verses.fr: Fréquemment en voyage, j''ai été en péril sur les fleuves, en péril de la part des brigands, en péril de la part de ceux de ma nation, en péril de la part des païens, en péril dans les villes, en péril dans les déserts, en péril sur la mer, en péril parmi les faux frères.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በመንገድ ሄድሁ፤ በወንዝ ፍርሃት፥ በወንበዴዎች ፍርሃት፥ በወገኔ በኩል ፍርሃት፥ በአሕዛብ በኩል ፍርሃት፥ በከተማ ፍርሃት፥ በምድረ በዳ ፍርሃት፥ በባሕር ፍርሃት፥ በውሸተኞች ወንድሞች በኩል ፍርሃት ነበረብኝ፤

verses.en: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
verses.fr: J''ai été dans le travail et dans la peine, exposé à de nombreuses veilles, à la faim et à la soif, à des jeûnes multipliés, au froid et à la nudité.
verses.am: በድካምና በጥረት ብዙ ጊዜም እንቅልፍ በማጣት፥ በራብና በጥም ብዙ ጊዜም በመጦም፥ በብርድና በራቁትነት ነበርሁ።

verses.en: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
